what_to_detect: A permanent that is a copy (copy_source set) has the copied object's copiable values: its base P/T and name match the source's printed values, without the source's counters or temporary boosts.
near_miss: A copy whose P/T includes the source's counters or temporary boosts.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A copy (copy_source set) takes the source's printed card types, not types a non-copy effect gives the source.
near_miss: A copy whose types include a type a non-copy effect gave the source.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A copy (copy_source set) has the source's colours and each of its abilities once.
near_miss: A copy missing the source's colours or holding its abilities twice.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A copy (copy_source set) keeps the copiable values it took when made after its source's copiable values change (a face-down source turned face up).
near_miss: A copy whose characteristics follow a later change to its source.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A permanent under a static copy effect (copy_source set) keeps the copiable values fixed when the effect first applied after its source changes.
near_miss: A static-copy permanent whose characteristics follow a later change to its source.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A copy whose source is itself a copy (a copy_source chain of two or more) has the first copy's copiable values, its exceptions included.
near_miss: A copy whose source is not a copy.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A trigger is evaluated on a copy (copy_source set) for an ability a copy effect granted as part of the copying, taken from a source that was itself a copy.
near_miss: The same trigger evaluated on a permanent that is not a copy.

what_to_detect: A permanent that becomes a copy while staying on the battlefield (permanent_copied in a Clone resolution, no zone_change of it) keeps the non-copy effects already applying to it.
near_miss: A permanent that becomes a copy and loses a non-copy effect that applied to it.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A permanent entering the battlefield as a copy (copy_source set) has an enters replacement it took from its source (enters tapped, enters with counters) replace its zone_change into the battlefield.
near_miss: A permanent entering as a copy of a source with no enters replacement, so only the copy replacement itself meets the zone_change.

what_to_detect: A permanent entering the battlefield as a copy (copy_source set) has an enters trigger it took from its source evaluated, and it fires.
near_miss: An enters trigger evaluated for a permanent that is not a copy.

what_to_detect: A permanent entering as a copy (copy_source set) carries its own as-enters choice rather than its source's.
near_miss: A copy whose as-enters choice is the source's.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A copy (copy_source set) of a double-faced or transformed permanent has the characteristics of the face up on its source.
near_miss: A copy of a permanent with its front face up.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A token copy (copy_source set, a token) of a double-faced permanent is itself double-faced and enters with its source's face up.
near_miss: A token copy of a single-faced permanent.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A copy (copy_source set) whose source is a copy with a modified characteristic (an added type) has that modification among its characteristics.
near_miss: A copy of an unmodified source, without the added characteristic.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A copy (copy_source set) made by an effect that does not copy a characteristic (colour) keeps its own value of it, differing from the source's.
near_miss: A copy made by an effect that copies the characteristic, matching the source.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A copy (copy_source set) made by an effect that sets P/T outright has those values, the source's characteristic-defining P/T ability not copied.
near_miss: A copy whose P/T comes from the source's copied characteristic-defining ability.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A copy (copy_source set) with an in-addition type exception keeps the source's characteristic-defining type ability (changeling: every creature type).
near_miss: A copy with an in-addition exception of a source without such an ability.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A permanent entering as a copy of a copy effect, a second copy effect applied after the first, gets none of the first effect's additional-effect exception (no counter_change from it).
near_miss: A permanent entering under a single copy effect whose exception adds its counters.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A copy (copy_source set) gets a conditional exception (counters, an added ability) only when the copy, without that exception, has the stated characteristic.
near_miss: A copy lacking the characteristic that still gets the exception.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, subtypes, colors, pt, counters

what_to_detect: A triggered ability linked to a copy-effect replacement is not evaluated, or does not fire, on a permanent to which a later copy effect applied (copy_source set).
near_miss: The linked trigger firing on a permanent under that copy effect alone.

what_to_detect: A copy of a spell whose effect depends on the mana spent to cast it resolves without that effect, its cost half recording no mana paid.
near_miss: The original spell resolving with the effect, its cost half recording the mana spent.

what_to_detect: A spell copy leaves the stack (countered or resolved) and ceases to exist: the record shows it leaving with no zone_change of it into a graveyard.
near_miss: A spell card countered or resolved that moves to its owner's graveyard.
record_fields: zone_change event from_zone stack, to_zone graveyard

what_to_detect: A copy effect naming a new target for the copy makes the copy only when that target is legal: the triggered ability's resolution holds spell_copied with new_targets when it is, and none when it is not.
near_miss: A resolution of the same copy effect whose specified target is illegal, holding no spell_copied event.
record_fields: spell_copied event (count, new_targets) in the triggered ability's resolution effect half (record kind resolution; the trigger record fires on both sides)
the acting chain's sub-ability API (the root line's API can be Token rather than CopySpellAbility)

what_to_detect: A copy of a permanent spell resolves and becomes a token permanent: the resolution's zone_change from the stack to the battlefield has a spell copy as its subject.
near_miss: A permanent spell that is a card resolves and enters the battlefield as a card, not a token.

what_to_detect: A copy of a double-faced permanent spell resolves into a double-faced token with its source's face up.
near_miss: A copy of a single-faced permanent spell.

what_to_detect: An ability that refers to its source by name affects that source after the source's name changed (it became a copy of something else): the event's subject is the source entity, whose current name is not the one the ability's text uses.
near_miss: The same ability resolving while its source still has the name its text uses.
record_fields: state.entities[].name and copy_source of the source

what_to_detect: A copy of a card created and cast by an effect (Play with a copied card) is cast as a spell, can be countered, and ceases to exist when it leaves the stack, with no zone_change of it into a graveyard.
near_miss: A card cast by such an effect that moves to a graveyard after resolving or being countered.

what_to_detect: A copy of a noted card made from the graveyard has the characteristics that card had as it last existed in the graveyard.
near_miss: A copy whose characteristics differ from the noted card's last-known graveyard values.
record_fields: state.entities[] name, types, mana_value of the copy on the stack
